__inputs.name: DS_POSTGRESQL
__inputs.label: PostgreSQL
__inputs.description: Postgres datasource pointing at the secops_dashboard database

title: Endpoint & Identity
description: Falcon sensor coverage and detections, removable media (USB writes and scans), Falcon Identity Protection risk, Entra ID risk/MFA and sign-in activity.

list.name: site
list.label: Site
list.query: SELECT site_label FROM dim_site ORDER BY site_label = 'Ungrouped', site_label

options.content: Falcon sensor coverage and detections, removable media, identity risk (Falcon Identity Protection) and Entra ID. Hover the **i** on any panel for exactly what it counts.
A **stale** sensor hasn't checked in for 7+ days: the host is unprotected and unassessed, or decommissioned but not removed from Falcon.

panels.title: Managed hosts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Devices with a Falcon sensor (not retired), whatever their last check-in.

panels.title: Stale sensors (7d+)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND last_seen < now() - interval '7 days'

panels.description: Managed hosts whose sensor hasn't checked in for 7+ days.

panels.title: Reduced functionality mode

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND lower(rfm) = 'yes'

panels.description: Sensors in RFM -- usually an unsupported kernel/OS build. Protection is degraded.

panels.title: Unmanaged assets seen

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Devices Falcon sensors saw on the network that have no sensor themselves.

panels.title: Sensor coverage

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE managed) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) FROM assets WHERE NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Managed / (managed + unmanaged-but-seen). Only as complete as Discover's visibility.

panels.title: Contained hosts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND containment ILIKE 'contain%'

panels.description: Hosts currently network-contained from the Falcon console.

panels.title: Coverage trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, sum(managed_hosts) AS "Managed", sum(unmanaged_assets) AS "Unmanaged", sum(stale_sensors) AS "Stale sensors" FROM daily_asset_metrics WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Managed, unmanaged and stale-sensor counts per day from the nightly snapshot.

panels.title: Stale / degraded sensors

targets.rawSql: SELECT hostname AS "Host", site_label AS "Site", product_type AS "Type", os_version AS "OS", sensor_version AS "Sensor", rfm AS "RFM", last_seen AS "Last seen", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - last_seen) / 86400.0, 1) AS "Days silent" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) AND (last_seen < now() - interval '7 days' OR lower(rfm) = 'yes') ORDER BY last_seen LIMIT 200

panels.description: Hosts silent 7+ days or in reduced-functionality mode, longest-silent first.

panels.title: Unmanaged assets

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(hostname, array_to_string(ips, ', ')) AS "Asset", site_label AS "Site", platform AS "Platform", os_version AS "OS", last_seen AS "Last seen", site_matched_by AS "Site matched by" FROM assets WHERE source = 'falcon_unmanaged' AND NOT retired AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY last_seen DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Devices Falcon saw on the network or in AD that have no sensor, most recently seen first.

options.content: Falcon endpoint and identity detections. Informational-severity alerts are counted here but excluded from the exec reports.

panels.title: Open alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Falcon detections not yet closed (any severity, including informational).

panels.title: Open Critical

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND severity = 'critical' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Critical-severity Falcon detections not yet closed.

panels.title: New in range

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: Falcon detections raised in the selected range.

panels.title: Median time to close (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM closed_at - created_at) / 3600.0))::numeric, 1) FROM security_alerts WHERE closed_at IS NOT NULL AND site_label IN ($site) AND closed_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND closed_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: Median hours from raised to closed, for detections closed in the range.

panels.title: Unassigned > 24h

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts WHERE status = 'new' AND created_at < now() - interval '24 hours' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Detections still 'new' (not picked up) a day after being raised.

panels.title: New alerts per day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'critical') AS "Critical", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'high') AS "High", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'medium') AS "Medium", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity = 'low') AS "Low" FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Falcon detections per day, stacked by severity.

panels.title: Top tactics (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(tactic, '(none)') AS "Tactic", count(*) AS "Alerts", count(*) FILTER (WHERE severity IN ('critical','high')) AS "Crit/High" FROM security_alerts WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 12

panels.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic of the detections raised in the range.

panels.title: Open alerts

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "Created", severity AS "Severity", status AS "Status", name AS "Alert", coalesce(hostname, user_name) AS "Host / user", site_label AS "Site", tactic AS "Tactic", product AS "Product", link AS "Link" FROM security_alerts WHERE status <> 'closed' AND site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 1 WHEN 'high' THEN 2 WHEN 'medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, created_at LIMIT 200

panels.description: Falcon detections not yet closed (any severity, including informational).

options.content: Files written to USB and other removable drives, and the scan Falcon runs when a drive is plugged in. **File-write history starts 5 Oct 2026** (Falcon keeps raw events about 7 days), so ranges reaching further back undercount; scan history goes back to 5 Sep.

panels.title: Files to removable media

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(files), 0) FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Files written to USB / removable drives in the range, all kinds.

panels.title: Business-data files

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(files) FILTER (WHERE category IN ('documents', 'data', 'email', 'clinical', 'archives')), 0) FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Files written to removable drives that are business data: documents, spreadsheets & data, email, medical images and archives (contents unknown, so counted as data).

panels.title: Email & medical images

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(files), 0) FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE category IN ('email', 'clinical') AND site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Outlook messages / mailbox exports and DICOM images written to removable drives -- the most sensitive categories.

panels.title: Data to removable media

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(sum(bytes), 0) FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Total size of the files written to removable drives in the range.

panels.title: People writing to USB

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT user_key) FILTER (WHERE user_key <> '') FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Distinct users who wrote any file to a removable drive (system writes excluded).

panels.title: Drives used

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT device_serial) FILTER (WHERE device_serial <> '') FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date

panels.description: Distinct removable drives (by serial) written to. Drives Falcon couldn't name aren't counted.

panels.title: Files written per day by category

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamp AS time, CASE category WHEN 'documents' THEN 'Documents' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Spreadsheets & data' WHEN 'email' THEN 'Email' WHEN 'clinical' THEN 'Medical images' WHEN 'archives' THEN 'Archives' WHEN 'images' THEN 'Images & media' WHEN 'software' THEN 'Applications & scripts' WHEN 'cad' THEN 'Design & CAD' WHEN 'system' THEN 'Disk images & system' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other' ELSE category END AS metric, sum(files) AS value FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Files written to removable drives per day, stacked by what kind of file.

panels.title: Business-data files by site

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_label AS "Site", sum(files) AS "Files" FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE category IN ('documents', 'data', 'email', 'clinical', 'archives') AND site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Business-data files written to removable drives in the range, per site.

panels.title: Top removable-media writers

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(display_name) AS "Name", max(user_name) AS "Account", max(department) AS "Department", max(title) AS "Title", string_agg(DISTINCT site_label, ', ') AS "Site", count(DISTINCT aid) AS "PCs", count(DISTINCT device_serial) FILTER (WHERE device_serial <> '') AS "Drives", COALESCE(sum(files) FILTER (WHERE category IN ('documents', 'data', 'email', 'clinical', 'archives')), 0) AS "Business files", COALESCE(sum(files) FILTER (WHERE category IN ('email', 'clinical')), 0) AS "Email / medical", sum(files) AS "All files", sum(bytes) AS "Data", string_agg(DISTINCT CASE category WHEN 'documents' THEN 'Documents' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Spreadsheets & data' WHEN 'email' THEN 'Email' WHEN 'clinical' THEN 'Medical images' WHEN 'archives' THEN 'Archives' WHEN 'images' THEN 'Images & media' WHEN 'software' THEN 'Applications & scripts' WHEN 'cad' THEN 'Design & CAD' WHEN 'system' THEN 'Disk images & system' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other' ELSE category END, ', ') AS "Categories", max(last_write) AS "Last write" FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE user_key <> '' AND site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY user_key ORDER BY 8 DESC, 10 DESC LIMIT 100

panels.description: People who wrote the most business-data files to removable drives in the range. Volume alone isn't wrongdoing -- check against role (imaging, records, IT).

panels.title: Email & medical image writes

targets.rawSql: SELECT day AS "Day", COALESCE(NULLIF(display_name, ''), NULLIF(user_name, ''), '(system)') AS "User", department AS "Department", hostname AS "PC", site_label AS "Site", CASE category WHEN 'documents' THEN 'Documents' WHEN 'data' THEN 'Spreadsheets & data' WHEN 'email' THEN 'Email' WHEN 'clinical' THEN 'Medical images' WHEN 'archives' THEN 'Archives' WHEN 'images' THEN 'Images & media' WHEN 'software' THEN 'Applications & scripts' WHEN 'cad' THEN 'Design & CAD' WHEN 'system' THEN 'Disk images & system' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Other' ELSE category END AS "Category", files AS "Files", bytes AS "Data", concat_ws(' ', device_make, device_model) AS "Drive", folder AS "Folder", array_to_string(sample_files, ', ') AS "Sample files" FROM usb_file_writes_daily WHERE category IN ('email', 'clinical') AND site_label IN ($site) AND day BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date ORDER BY files DESC, bytes DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Every PC x user x drive x folder group in the range that wrote Outlook mail, mailbox exports or DICOM images, largest first. Sample files are the largest names in the group.

panels.title: USB scans (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM usb_scans WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_on >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_on < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: On-demand scans Falcon ran when a drive was plugged in.

panels.title: Incomplete scans

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM usb_scans WHERE status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completed' AND site_label IN ($site) AND created_on >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_on < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: USB scans that didn't finish -- usually the drive was removed mid-scan.

panels.title: Scans finding malware

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM usb_scans WHERE files_malicious > 0 AND site_label IN ($site) AND created_on >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_on < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: USB scans that found at least one malicious file.

panels.title: Detections from USB scans

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM security_alerts a JOIN usb_scans s ON s.scan_id = a.scan_id WHERE a.site_label IN ($site) AND a.created_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND a.created_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: Falcon detections raised by a USB scan in the range.

panels.title: Recent USB scans

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_on AS "Started", hostname AS "PC", site_label AS "Site", status AS "Status", array_to_string(drives, ', ') AS "Drives", files_traversed AS "Files seen", files_scanned AS "Scanned", files_malicious AS "Malicious", files_quarantined AS "Quarantined", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM completed_on - created_on) / 60.0, 1) AS "Minutes" FROM usb_scans WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND created_on >= '${__from:date}'::date AND created_on < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 ORDER BY files_malicious DESC NULLS LAST, created_on DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: USB insertion scans in the range, ones that found malware first.

options.content: Current state from the latest Identity Protection pull; trends from the nightly snapshot. **Enabled** includes accounts whose status is unknown.

panels.title: High-risk accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND risk_severity = 'high' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Accounts Falcon Identity Protection currently rates high risk.

panels.title: Medium-risk accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND risk_severity = 'medium' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Accounts Falcon Identity Protection currently rates medium risk.

panels.title: Enabled, password > 1 year

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities WHERE NOT retired AND enabled AND password_last_change < now() - interval '365 days' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Enabled accounts whose password was last changed over a year ago.

panels.title: Enabled accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM identity_entities e WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.enabled IS NOT FALSE AND COALESCE(e.account_kind, 'human') <> 'out_of_scope' AND e.site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Enabled (or unknown-status) accounts, all kinds: people, service, mailbox, generic, VPN / remote-app. The denominator for the stale percentages.

panels.title: Stale: all enabled accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM identity_entities e WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.enabled IS NOT FALSE AND COALESCE(e.account_kind, 'human') <> 'out_of_scope' AND e.site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Enabled accounts Falcon Identity flags STALE_ACCOUNT (no recent activity). Disable or confirm still needed.

panels.title: Stale: people's main accounts

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM identity_risk_factors f WHERE f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id AND f.factor_type = 'STALE_ACCOUNT')) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM identity_entities e WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.enabled IS NOT FALSE AND COALESCE(e.account_kind, 'human') <> 'out_of_scope' AND e.site_label IN ($site) AND COALESCE(e.account_kind, 'human') = 'human' AND e.access_account IS NULL

panels.description: As left, for human accounts only, excluding service / mailbox / generic accounts and shared-domain VPN / remote-app second accounts: roughly, staff who've left or moved on.

panels.title: Accounts by risk factor

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.factor_type AS "Factor", count(DISTINCT f.entity_id) AS "Accounts" FROM identity_risk_factors f JOIN identity_entities e ON e.source = f.source AND e.entity_id = f.entity_id WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Accounts carrying each Falcon Identity risk factor right now (one account can have several).

panels.title: Risk factor trend

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, replace(metric, 'factor:', '') AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM daily_identity_metrics WHERE metric LIKE 'factor:%' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Accounts per risk factor per day, from the nightly snapshot.

panels.title: Stale accounts, % of enabled

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'cat:stale_accounts') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'total:enabled_accounts'), 0), 1) AS "All enabled accounts", round(100.0 * sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'total:stale_people') / NULLIF(sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'total:enabled_people'), 0), 1) AS "People's main accounts" FROM daily_identity_metrics WHERE metric IN ('cat:stale_accounts', 'total:enabled_accounts', 'total:stale_people', 'total:enabled_people') AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1 HAVING sum(value) FILTER (WHERE metric = 'total:enabled_accounts') > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: From the nightly identity snapshot (history from 14 Oct 2026, when the enabled-account totals started being recorded).

panels.title: Identity remediation list

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(e.upn, e.display_name) AS "Account", e.sam_account_name AS "sAMAccountName", e.domain AS "Domain", e.site_label AS "Site", e.risk_severity AS "Severity", round(e.risk_score::numeric, 2) AS "Score", string_agg(f.factor_type, ', ' ORDER BY f.factor_type) AS "Risk factors", e.enabled AS "Enabled", round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - e.password_last_change) / 86400.0) AS "Password age (days)", e.ou AS "OU" FROM identity_entities e LEFT JOIN identity_risk_factors f ON f.source = e.source AND f.entity_id = e.entity_id WHERE NOT e.retired AND e.site_label IN ($site) AND e.risk_severity IN ('high','medium') GROUP BY e.source, e.entity_id, e.upn, e.display_name, e.sam_account_name, e.domain, e.site_label, e.risk_severity, e.risk_score, e.enabled, e.password_last_change, e.ou ORDER BY e.risk_score DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 500

panels.description: Work list for the service desk (users) and cyber/systems (privileged/service accounts).

options.content: Entra ID Protection risk and MFA registration (needs the Entra app registration; empty until the **entra** collector is enabled).

panels.title: Users at risk

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risky_users WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Users Entra ID Protection currently flags at risk.

panels.title: Confirmed compromised

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risky_users WHERE risk_state = 'confirmedCompromised' AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Users an admin marked confirmed compromised in Entra ID Protection.

panels.title: Risk detections (range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entra_risk_detections WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND detected_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND detected_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1

panels.description: Entra ID Protection risk detections (unfamiliar sign-in, leaked credentials, ...) in the range.

panels.title: MFA registered

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mfa_registered) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Share of member users with an MFA method registered (guests excluded).

panels.title: Admins without MFA

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE is_admin AND NOT is_mfa_registered AND site_label IN ($site)

panels.description: Users holding an admin role with no MFA method registered. Should be zero.

panels.title: MFA registration by site

targets.rawSql: SELECT site_label AS "Site", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_mfa_registered) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 1) AS "MFA %" FROM entra_mfa_registration WHERE site_label IN ($site) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2

panels.description: Share of member users with MFA registered, per site.

panels.title: Risky users

targets.rawSql: SELECT upn AS "User", site_label AS "Site", risk_level AS "Risk", risk_state AS "State", risk_detail AS "Detail", risk_last_updated AS "Updated", tenant AS "Tenant" FROM entra_risky_users WHERE site_label IN ($site) ORDER BY CASE risk_level WHEN 'high' THEN 1 WHEN 'medium' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, risk_last_updated DESC

panels.description: Entra ID Protection's current risky-user list.

panels.title: Recent risk detections

targets.rawSql: SELECT detected_at AS "Detected", upn AS "User", site_label AS "Site", risk_event_type AS "Type", risk_level AS "Risk", risk_state AS "State", ip_address AS "IP", concat_ws(', ', city, country) AS "Location" FROM entra_risk_detections WHERE site_label IN ($site) AND detected_at >= '${__from:date}'::date AND detected_at < '${__to:date}'::date + 1 ORDER BY detected_at DESC LIMIT 200

panels.description: Entra ID Protection risk detections in the range, newest first.

panels.title: Sign-ins: success vs failure

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'signins' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Entra sign-ins per day from Log Analytics.

panels.title: MFA denied

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'mfa_failures' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sign-ins where the user denied or failed the MFA prompt, per day.

panels.title: Legacy authentication by client

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'legacy_auth' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sign-ins using legacy protocols (IMAP, POP, SMTP auth, ...) that can't do MFA, per day.

panels.title: Risky sign-ins

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'risky_signins' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sign-ins Entra rated risky, per day by risk level.

panels.title: Conditional Access blocks

targets.rawSql: SELECT snapshot_date::timestamp AS time, dimension AS metric, sum(value) AS value FROM azure_log_metrics WHERE query_name = 'ca_failures' AND site_label IN ($site) AND snapshot_date BETWEEN '${__from:date}'::date AND '${__to:date}'::date GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Sign-ins blocked by a Conditional Access policy, per day.
